title: Observe the reviewer MCP bridge before cleanup when Codex finishes without a submitted result
outcome: Separate finish-without-submission diagnostic slice (ask2), per Fable2 mailbox1342/message-923648b5-16d0-40d1-a296-91506cfa23df under Greg's smaller-landings rule. Startup fail-fast/explicit startup budget remain in the parent. No owner yet; Coder/session7422 likely implements after parent's landing and a new claim/source-root naming. Trigger: coordinator assignment after parent lands; this filing itself promises no implementation. Preserve fail-first test-7e855f39 evidence: actual turn/completed yielded thread/archive instead of status query. This is separate from the disabled-mailbox positive fixture defect.
acceptance: A Codex reviewer finishing without an authoritative submission triggers another bounded termal-server status query before terminal cleanup/archive discards its MCP state. The typed observation (including an explicitly unavailable observation and any captured startup reason) is retained in the failed delegation result and child transcript. It remains a failed/unavailable review, not a fabricated clean result. A valid authoritative submitted result retains existing precedence and is not overwritten by later MCP/transport failure.

Permanent transport/lifecycle controls cover finishing-without-submission and a healthy authoritative submission. The integration neither blocks the JSON-RPC reader nor holds the state lock while awaiting status, does not damage a sibling thread or shared app-server, and does not settle a stopped/replaced reviewer. Transcript/result diagnostics are bounded and omit raw config, environment secrets, routing credentials and unrelated tool inventories. Existing permission/write-policy and immutable-submission safeguards remain unchanged.
